test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: During the previous year, the price of an electronic item increased by 10%, and this year, the price of the same item decreased by 10%. If the price of the electronic item at present is ₹66,000, then what was the price of the discussed electronic item in the beginning of the previous year? (Rounded off to one decimal place)
solution:
**Given:- **

The price of the electronic item at present is ₹66,000

**Calculation:-**

Let's assume the price of the electronic item

at the beginning of the previous year was "P" rupees.

Price at the end of previous year = P + (10P/100)&nbs
